'''Axis Spinpistol''' is the quartermaster for the [[Gnomeregan Exiles]] and is located in the [[Gnomeregan Reclamation Facility]] in [[Dun Morogh]].

==Speculation==
* He may be related to [[Clover Spinpistol]].
